faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about JAFZA Free Zone. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.a: JAFZA (Jebel Ali Free Zone) is one of the world's largest and most prestigious free zones, home to over 9,500 companies from 100+ countries. Located next to Jebel Ali Port — the largest port in the Middle East — JAFZA offers world-class trade, logistics, and industrial infrastructure with 100% foreign ownership.

JAFZA is located in Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE — adjacent to Jebel Ali Port and close to Al Maktoum International Airport. It provides strategic access to major shipping routes, highways (E11, E311), and key markets across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia.

items.q: What is included in the JAFZA setup package?
items.a: Depending on the package, you get the Free Zone license, residency visa, medical & Emirates ID, lease agreement, bank account assistance, premium address, and free VAT consultation.

items.q: How much does a JAFZA package cost?
items.a: Our JAFZA packages start from AED 5,999 (Economy) and go up to AED 16,999 (Mainland + Residency). Premium packages with visa start at AED 14,499.
Typically 3-7 working days for license issuance, and additional 1-2 weeks for visa processing and bank account opening.
Yes. All packages are starting points and can be customized to match your trading, logistics, industrial, or service business needs and budget.

items.q: Do I get a UAE residency visa?
items.a: Yes, select packages include a UAE investor/residency visa with medical, Emirates ID, and status change. The Free Zone License with Lifetime UAE Residency even offers lifetime residency.
Yes. All packages include free assistance with corporate bank account opening at top UAE banks.

items.q: What activities can I do in JAFZA?
items.a: JAFZA supports general trading & import/export, logistics & supply chain, maritime & port services, warehousing & storage, manufacturing & assembly, engineering & industrial, and other commercial industries — with up to 5 activities in most economy packages.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for JAFZA setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, trade & logistics expertise, dedicated consultants, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to bank account. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
